title: Drop Every N'th Element From a List
required_features: A recursive logical measure/relation with an accumulator or state parameter that may change on recursive calls while another parameter remains fixed; the pinned Synquid resolver forbids changing any measure constant argument.
Equivalently, an index-aware sequence refinement relation sufficient to state that exactly positions n, 2n, 3n, ... are removed while retained occurrences remain in order.
semantic_obligations: For every positive n, use 1-based input positions.
Remove exactly positions i for which i mod n = 0.
Keep all other elements in original order.
Preserve multiplicity of all retained occurrences; do not reduce the requirement to sets or lengths.
Return [] for an empty input and for n = 1; return the original sequence when n exceeds its length.
Do not assert behavior for n <= 0, because the authoritative source does not specify it.
